faqs.question: How do I register to vote in India?
faqs.answer: You can register online at voters.eci.gov.in or the NVSP portal by filling Form 6. You need to be an Indian citizen aged 18+ on the qualifying date. You can also visit your local BLO (Booth Level Officer) for assistance.

faqs.question: What documents do I need to vote?
faqs.answer: Your EPIC (Voter ID card) is the primary document. Alternatively, you can use any of 12 approved IDs: Aadhaar, PAN card, Passport, Driving License, Bank Passbook with photo, etc.

faqs.question: How does EVM voting work?
faqs.answer: The Electronic Voting Machine (EVM) has a ballot unit with candidate names and symbols. Press the button next to your chosen candidate. The VVPAT slip will display your vote for 7 seconds for verification.

faqs.question: What is the Model Code of Conduct?
faqs.answer: The Model Code of Conduct (MCC) is a set of guidelines issued by the ECI for political parties and candidates during elections. It comes into effect from the date of announcement of elections and remains in force till the completion of the election process.

milestones.description: Election Commission of India announces the election schedule. Model Code of Conduct comes into effect.
Candidates file their nomination papers with the Returning Officer.
Scrutiny of nomination papers by the Returning Officer.
Active campaigning period. Campaigning must stop 48 hours before polling.
Voting day for Phase 1 constituencies. Polling hours: 7 AM to 6 PM.
EVMs opened and votes counted at designated counting centres.
Final results declared. Winners receive certificates from the Returning Officer.
